title: Labor Rate Cap and Aggregate Claim Limit by Kessler Shield Coverage Level
content:
Each Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts coverage level caps the hourly labor rate the contract pays and limits what the contract pays over its life.

| Coverage level | Labor-rate cap (USD per hour) | Aggregate claim limit (USD) | Diagnosis and teardown paid on a covered failure |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Shield Powertrain | 135.00 | 15000.00 | yes |
| Kessler Shield Powertrain Plus | 140.00 | 20000.00 | yes |
| Kessler Shield Select | 150.00 | 25000.00 | yes |
| Kessler Shield Preferred | 160.00 | 30000.00 | yes |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary | 175.00 | 40000.00 | yes |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap | 175.00 | 40000.00 | yes |

**Labor-rate cap.** This is the highest hourly labor rate the contract pays. Where the store's posted customer-pay rate is above the cap, the customer owes the store the hourly difference.

**Aggregate claim limit.** This is the most the contract pays across all its claims over its whole life. It is measured as claims paid less claims reversed. The part of the limit the contract has not paid out is the limit less that net figure.

**Example (hypothetical).** A Kessler Shield Select contract with a hypothetical 24612.40 paid and 380.00 reversed has 25000.00 less 24232.40 left, which is 767.60.
